notes: Small workflow tidy-up build. The existing linked RA/COSHH impact screen is now the single change-control workspace. It shows the replacement source version, revision training-impact status, linked SSW/TBT review progress and final approval readiness together. Managers can set the replacement version's No retraining / Self-training / Instructor-led training impact directly in this workspace, including the same residual-risk guidance and high-risk override justification used by the approval screen. Existing linked actions remain in the same place: open current, review/keep as-is, modify/new version, in-app edit where available, temporarily block and clear block. The workspace shows clear step-by-step traffic-light status and a final Review & approve source button when appropriate. The controlled approval screen and exact-file acknowledgement remain the final authorisation step; this build does not weaken approval controls or duplicate audit records. No database migration was required.
